tools.name: get_firm_overview
tools.description: Facts about ClearMind Capital LLC, a fee-only fiduciary registered investment adviser in Columbus, Ohio: services, advisers and credentials, fee schedules, custodian, regulatory IDs (CRD), contact details, and links to the Form ADV summary and SEC record. Use for any question about the firm itself.

tools.name: find_401k_plan
tools.description: Search the public U.S. Department of Labor Form 5500-SF filings that power the ClearMind 401(k) Scorecard (Ohio 401(k) plans that file the 5500-SF, usually under 100 participants). Search by company or plan name, or by the 9-digit EIN. Returns plan_id values for get_401k_scorecard_preview.

tools.name: get_401k_scorecard_preview
tools.description: Preview of the ClearMind 401(k) Scorecard for one plan: overall 0-100 score, band (Strength, Monitor, Priority), headline, and a short story of the plan, scored from its latest public Form 5500-SF filing. Not an audit or compliance determination. The full five-area breakdown is on the Scorecard page
